frequency_question: How often does a central bank resume rate hikes after an extended pause late in a tightening cycle?
membership_rule: Scheduled central bank policy rate decision meetings occurring within 18 months of a primary tightening cycle peak, specifically where the policy rate has been held steady for at least four consecutive meetings prior to the decision.
provenance_note: 3 cases named, 5 claimed via skeleton x multiplier (1.7x)
coverage_note: 5 named historical instances of post-pause late-cycle meetings across G10 authorities; 1 resulted in a hike.
known_gaps: Excludes emerging market central banks which exhibit different inflation persistence dynamics.
skeleton: Total historical late-cycle resumption attempts matching structural pause criteria divided by total observed late-cycle pauses.
multiplier: 2 active resumption attempts in comparable late-cycle environments evaluated across major G10 central banks since 1990.
validity_reason: Structural central bank reaction functions and post-pandemic inflation regime dynamics remain comparable through the medium term.
